<thought>Only carbon shows a clear 13C isotopic envelope (M+1 ~6.7% of M), which matches the expected ~1.1% per carbon for about six carbons. No other element exhibits its characteristic isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
